subject: LumenAI procurement & marketplace next steps
messages:
From: camila_reyes
To: Jordan Ellison <jordan.ellison@lumenai.com>
Cc: marissa_cole, dylan_brooks
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: LumenAI procurement & marketplace next steps

Hi Jordan - great to meet you on the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a mutual action plan:

Recap:
- Use case: LumenAI wants to integrate Redwood inference for low-latency, multi-tenant embeddings and chat across their inference pipeline.
- Scale: pilot ~5k monthly active requests, ramp to ~200k requests over 6-9 months.
- Security: SSO (SAML/OIDC) required, SOC2 evidence requested.

Procurement / commercial path items discussed:
1) Procurement preference: you mentioned Procurement prefers PO-based billing vs. corporate card if we go via an invoice.
2) Marketplace interest: you said AWS Marketplace would be the primary route, GCP may be considered later; Azure not in scope right now.
3) Legal: Procurement will need an MSA + standard security attachments.
4) Timeline: target contract signed by end of June to hit Q3 pilot.

Next steps (proposed):
- I will send our marketplace buyer guide + a draft MSA for Procurement's review (attached).
- Can you share the procurement contact(s) and any internal marketplace onboarding owner?
- If AWS Marketplace is preferred, confirm whether you need an AMI/Private Offer or just SaaS via Marketplace (metered/invoice).

Attachments: Redwood marketplace buyer guide, draft MSA (for redline).

I'll follow up with a timeline for a short procurement kickoff once I have the contact. Thanks - Camila

--
Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila@redwood.example.com
Mobile: (415) 555-0192

From: Jordan Ellison <jordan.ellison@lumenai.com>
To: camila_reyes
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@lumenai.com>
Date: Wed, 13 May 2026 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: LumenAI procurement & marketplace next steps

Thanks Camila - super helpful recap. A few clarifications from Procurement side:

- Procurement lead: I looped in procurement@lumenai.com (they're the shared inbox for our procurement team). Primary contact is Avery Mills (avery.mills@lumenai.com) - I can intro via email if that helps.
- Billing preference: We prefer PO / Net 30 invoices for enterprise contracts; card only for initial eval purchases under $5k.
- Marketplace: We are strongly leaning to AWS Marketplace with a Private Offer so we can get consolidated invoicing and our finance team can apply existing AWS billing flow. We may consider GCP marketplace later but it's not in scope for Q3.
- Security docs: SOC2 type II report + architecture diagram + data flow statement are required. Can you confirm where to upload those?

On timing: if we can get a draft MSA and the marketplace offer set up by the end of May, Procurement will prioritize review and we could get approvals in June.

Happy to have a quick 15-minute procurement intro with Avery next week. Let me know times.

Best,
Jordan
Director, Platform Integrations | LumenAI
jordan.ellison@lumenai.com

From: camila_reyes

Jordan / Procurement team - thanks for the quick reply and the clarity on PO + AWS Private Offer. Attaching the buyer guide and a draft MSA for initial redlines.

Quick checklist and what I can do to help speed things up:
- Attachments: "redwood_marketplace_buyer_guide.pdf" and "redwood_msa_for_review.docx" (attached).
- Marketplace onboarding: here's our onboarding doc with steps for AWS Marketplace private offer creation and required fields: https://redwood.example.com/marketplace/onboarding (shared link).
- Security artifacts: I'll send SOC2 report and standard architecture/data-flow docs via a secure share (we use Box). If procurement prefers a specific upload location, please point me to it.
- Next meeting: I'm available for a 15-min procurement intro Monday 5/18 between 10-12 PT; otherwise Tuesday morning is open.

Ask from Procurement: please confirm the legal review owner and the billing contact (finance@lumenai.com if different from procurement@lumenai.com).

I'll also open a HubSpot procurement task and attach these docs to the deal so your reviewers have a single source of truth.

Next steps (agreed):
1) Jordan to intro Avery Mills (procurement) to this thread.
2) Procurement to confirm upload location for security artifacts and the billing contact.
3) Redwood to begin Marketplace Private Offer setup once we have the Procurement contact and a signed PO template.

Thanks - Camila

Camila Reyes

camila@redwood.example.com

From: marissa_cole
To: camila_reyes, dylan_brooks
Date: Thu, 14 May 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: LumenAI procurement & marketplace next steps

Looping in a quick internal note - thanks for driving this, Camila. A few internal asks from ops/legal before we push Private Offer setup:

- Marissa (Legal) needs to confirm the payment term expectation (PO + Net 30) and whether any prepayment or escrow language is requested. I can prep our standard Addendum for AWS Private Offer (reduces legal turnaround).
- Dylan (PS/Onboarding): once Procurement confirms upload location for SOC2, please prepare the onboarding checklist for LumenAI (SSO/SAML metadata, account mapping for pilot team, billing contact fields).
- Can we confirm pricing band for the pilot (5k requests/month) vs. ramp pricing? I propose we offer the standard Pilot tier (25% discount) with an option to convert to committed reserved capacity for Dedicated if they hit 100k requests.

I'll wait for Jordan's intro to Avery and will ping Legal to prepare the addendum.

- Marissa
Legal Counsel | Redwood Inference
